qtfw8f75.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 150 cm
qtfw8f75.sourceDescription: This Modern Metal Christmas tree exemplifies contemporary elegance, combining the simplicity of minimalist design with the charm of holiday cheer. Styled in a gleaming gold hue and a matte finish, it presents a tasteful blend of style and simplicity suited for any modern home setting. Its sleek form and contour make it an ideal centerpiece for living rooms or hallways, blending seamlessly into any seasonal decor scheme. Tailored for the modern holiday enthusiast, it projects a festive yet understated aura that is both captivating and inviting. Materials: Made from powder-coated steel, this Metal Christmas tree stands out with its robust, abrasion-resistant qualities. The selection of material not only contributes to a sleek modern look but ensures durability and lasting use through several festive seasons. Included Components: The tree features an integrated sturdy steel stand, providing reliable stability to keep it firmly upright. This component minimizes the need for additional supports, making setup straightforward and quick. Features /Function /Design: The tree embodies modern design, offering clean lines and minimal ornamentation. Its gold matte finish enhances its visual appeal, giving a chic touch to traditional Christmas decor while maintaining a functional and practical setup. Recommended Uses: This tree is perfect for both living room and hallway spaces. Its refined elegance easily transforms any indoor or sheltered outdoor area into a festive environment, allowing you to celebrate in style, whether you're entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet holiday. Care &Maintenance: Assemble the tree according to the manufacturer's instructions. Once the festive season is over, disassemble and store it carefully to preserve its condition for future use. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: Powder-coated steel Tree height: 150 cm Stand size: 55 x 24 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Metal Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

ma70n6w3.variantName: COSTWAY 7.5 FT Pre-Lit Pencil Artificial Christmas Tree-Green
ma70n6w3.sourceDescription: This tree is made to brighten holiday decorating with a slim shape that fits smaller rooms while still offering a rich seasonal look. warm white lights are already installed, so setup feels simpler and your space looks festive sooner. Lights on or lights off is up to you! The hinged structure helps each section open smoothly, and the folding metal stand adds dependable support during the season and easier storage afterward. Built for repeated holiday use, this tree uses quality PVC branch tips that are flame-retardant, smell-free, non-allergic and resistant to fading over time. With branch tips, its layered greenery gives it a more natural presence indoors. Note: Ornaments are not included. Warm Seasonal Shine: This lighted Christmas tree comes pre-lit with warm white LED lights that cast a cozy glow across the room. It creates an inviting holiday atmosphere without the time and mess of hanging separate light strands. Premium PVC Materials: Made with high-quality materials, this artificial Christmas tree comes with flame-retardant branches and is fully smell-free as well as non-allergic to offer safe holiday decoration. Additionally, its anti-fading foliage keeps vibrant year-round, enabling stable and long-lasting seasonal reuse. Layered Branch Beauty: With branch tips, this realistic Christmas tree presents dense layered foliage. Moreover, it maintains an evergreen look, giving your indoor decoration a natural and polished holiday presence. Faster Setup Design: This pencil Christmas tree features a section design for easy assembly. Meanwhile, it comes with hinged branches that automatically spread out to the designated space. What’s more, folding metal stand ensures convenient storage and single pin simplifies installation. Space-Saving Holiday Shape: Designed as a slim Christmas tree, it brings lifelike seasonal charm in a pencil shape. The slim Xmas tree fits beautifully in apartments, corners, entryways and other smaller spaces without overwhelming the room. zh7nf2z3.sourceDescription: Introducing the 60cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Gold, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. vz69xdb1.sourceDescription: VeryMerry 60cm Christmas Wreath 2in1 Dual-Color - Warm White/Multi Colour with 40 LED Lights Pre Lit | Christmas Outdoor&Indoor Door Decorations PRE-LIT CHRISTMAS WREATH: Let your home shine brighter with this VeryMerry 60cm LED Christmas Wreath which can be set to warm white or multi-colour and features 40 beaming bulbs. This decoration is sure to add a sparkle to your home over the festive season by enhancing the traditional Christmas theme. The wreath boasts 126 PVC tips, pine cones and holly berries to give it a full and realistic look. 8 LIGHTING FUNCTIONS AND TIMER: This set of multifunctional string lights features 8 lighting modes to choose from, including Combination, Steady On, Slow Fade, In Waves, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Sequential and Twinkle/Flash. The different lighting effects are controlled by a button on the battery pack which make it easier than ever to achieve your desired lighting effects. The built-in timer allows for 8 hours of illumination followed by 16 hours off, repeating daily. Set it once and enjoy a worry-free, automated lighting display that adapts to your schedule. SAFE FOR INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: Designed with safety and longevity in mind, this LED tree operates on 3 x AA batteries (Batteries NOT Included) and produces minimal heat, making it safe to the touch even during extended use. Ideal for households with kids and pets, the lights are built to last while remaining cool, energy-efficient, and cost-effective throughout the seasons. This wreath can be used indoor or outdoor due to the waterproof, low voltage battery pack and it is also made of fire-resistant material for extra peace of mind. PRODUCT DIMENSIONS: This wreath has a diameter of 60cm and is 12cm thick. It weighs just 0.85kg so you will have no issues hanging it on your door. Please refer to the product packaging and user manual for applicable safety warnings and instructions. Consumable Direct Ltd, 78 Cawdor St, Eccles, Manchester, M30 0QF
